08c_1_cancel_and_survive.png: The term $\gamma^\mu\Omega_\mu$ of the field equation in the diagonal frame of the corrected metric, direction by direction (no sum) and summed. Left: the coefficient of $\gamma^{(4)}$, split into its part with $a_4'$ (purple, in units of $a_4'$) and its part with $b_4'/b_4$ (orange, in units of $b_4'/b_4$): the three 3-space directions give $+\frac12$ each and the three extra times $-\frac12$ each, which cancel, but the hidden direction $x_0$ adds $-\frac12$; the four directions of the hidden block give $\frac14b_4'/b_4$ each; the sums are $-\frac12$ and $1$, so $v_g = b_4'/b_4 - a_4'/2$. Right: the coefficient of $\gamma^{(0)}$ in units of $He^{a_4}b_4^{-1/2}$; only the three extra times (red) contribute, $\frac12$ each, and the sum is $\frac32$: $c_g = \frac32He^{a_4}b_4^{-1/2}$. Exact values from sympy, for all functions $a_4$, $b_4$.
08c_2_pieces_along_history.png: Along the canonical history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ of the Kohn-Sham record ($A = H = 1$, a prescribed background) at $z = \pi/4$, against the time $x_4$. Left, logarithmic axis: four components of the spin connection of the diagonal frame; that of the inflating direction $x_1$ grows like $e^{a_4}$, those with the rate $h_4 = b_4'/(2b_4) - a_4' = -\frac13$ of the hidden direction and of the extra time $x_5$ shrink like $e^{-a_4}b_4^{1/2} = e^{-x_4/3}$, and $HW$ stays constant. Right: the parts of the term: the coefficient $c_g$ of $\gamma^{(0)}$ grows like $e^{x_4/3}$ as the hidden block deflates, while the coefficient of $\gamma^{(4)}$, the sum of the 3-space part $\frac32a_4' = \frac32$ and of the hidden-block part $2h_4 = -\frac23$, stays at $v_g = \frac56$.
08c_3_boost_size.png: The size $\sqrt{\mathrm{tr}(M^TM)/16}$ of the term $M = \gamma'^\mu\Omega'_\mu$ of the field equation in frames boosted in the $(x_4, x_0)$ plane, on the history of the Revision record ($c_g = \frac32e^{x_4/3}$, $v_g = \frac56$ for $H = 1$); sizes in units of $H$. Left: against the rapidity rate $\beta = b'(0)$ at $x_4 = 0$ with $b(0) = 0$; the diagonal frame gives $\sqrt{106}/6 \approx 1.716$, and the size $\sqrt{(c_g - \beta/2)^2 + v_g^2}$ is smallest, $v_g = \frac56$, at $\beta = 2c_g = 3$. Right: against the time $x_4$ (logarithmic axis) for the diagonal frame, a constant rate $b = 3x_4$, the removing rapidity $b = 9(e^{x_4/3} - 1)$, whose rate is $2c_g$ at every time and whose term $v_g(\cosh b\,\gamma^{(4)} - \sinh b\,\gamma^{(0)})$ has the size $v_g\sqrt{\cosh 2b}$, never zero, and half of it. The metric is the same in every one of these frames.
08c_4_heat_maps.png: The $16 \times 16$ matrix $\gamma^\mu\Omega_\mu$ of the field equation as a colour map (rows and columns numbered from 0; red positive, blue negative, white zero; entries in units of $H$, $H = 1$, time $x_4 = 0.3$, on the history of the Revision record, where $c_g = \frac32e^{0.1} = 1.658$ and $v_g = \frac56$). Left: diagonal frame, $c_g\gamma^{(0)} + v_g\gamma^{(4)}$, sixteen entries $c_g$ and sixteen entries $\pm v_g$. Middle: frame boosted with the constant rate $b = 3x_4$ ($b = 0.9$). Right: frame boosted with the removing rapidity $b = 9(e^{x_4/3} - 1)$ ($b = 0.946$), only $v_g(\cosh b\,\gamma^{(4)} - \sinh b\,\gamma^{(0)})$: the part $c_g\gamma^{(0)}$ is gone, the part $v_g$ is not. Same metric, same field equation, different frames.
08c_5_curvature_maps.png: The spinor curvature $F_{x_5x_0} = \partial_5\Omega_0 - \partial_0\Omega_5 + \Omega_5\Omega_0 - \Omega_0\Omega_5$ as a $16 \times 16$ colour map (red positive, blue negative, white zero; units of $H^2$) at $H = 1$, $z = \pi/4$, $x_4 = 0.5$ along the history of the Revision record; each panel has its own colour scale. Left: diagonal frame, $c_{05}\gamma^{(0)}\gamma^{(5)}$ with $c_{05} = -0.434$. Right: the frame boosted with the removing rapidity $b = 9(e^{x_4/3} - 1) = 1.632$, in which the part $c_g\gamma^{(0)}$ of the term $\gamma'^\mu\Omega'_\mu$ is gone; there the curvature is $c_{05}(\cosh b\,\gamma^{(0)}\gamma^{(5)} - \sinh b\,\gamma^{(4)}\gamma^{(5)})$. Neither is zero: the curvature is one quarter of the Riemann tensor contracted with two gammas, so no choice of frame can make the spin connection vanish. Both matrices have rank 16.
